description: TTC Subway Shapefiles is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This dataset contains separate shape files for the four major TTC routes (lines), as well as a consolidated shape file for all four routes. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-03-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
